final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Alert points at entry_service=ts-preserve-service: POST /api/v1/preserveservice/preserve returns 404 Not Found (20 occurrences). Yet ts-preserve-service is fully healthy: pod 2/2 Running with 0 restarts, endpoints bound at 172.20.3.154:14568, TCP connectivity succeeds from worker-01/02/03, and its error log is empty - so the request never reaches it. The namespace-wide pod scan shows no pending/crash/image-pull/mount anomaly and the events surface carries no Warning naming the preserve chain. The break is in the address layer: in ts-gateway-service-config (ConfigMap of app ts-gateway-service) the route 'preserve' is declared as uri: lb://${ORDER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-order-service} while its predicate is Path=/api/v1/preserveservice/**, i.e. the only route in the 40-route table whose uri target service differs from the owner of its Path prefix (sibling 'preserve-other' correctly points to ts-preserve-other-service). Traffic for the preserve path is therefore rewired into ts-order-service, whose logs contain only its own handlers (getOrderById/saveChanges/queryOrders/modifyOrder) and no preserve controller, hence the 404. Root cause: mis-wired gateway route (gateway_misrouted) on the route table's owner ts-gateway-service; ts-preserve-service is the victim that loses its availability.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service-config
data:
  application.yml: |-
    # HTTP Server
    server:
      port: 18888  # HTTP (Tomcat) port

    spring:
      main:
        web-application-type: reactive
      application:
        name: ts-gateway-service
      cloud:
        nacos:
          discovery:
            server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDRS:127.0.0.1:8848}
        gateway:
          routes:
            - id: admin-basic-info
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_BASIC_INFO_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-basic-info-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminbasicservice/**

            - id: admin-order
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ORDER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-order-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminorderservice/**

            - id: admin-route
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_ROUTE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-route-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminrouteservice/**

            - id: admin-travel
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_TRAVEL_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-travel-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/admintravelservice/**

            - id: admin-user
              uri: lb://${ADMIN_USER_SERVICE_HOST:ts-admin-user-service}
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/v1/adminuserservice/users/**

            - id: assurance
              uri: lb://${ASSURANCE_SERVICE_HOST:ts-assurance-service}
              predicates:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-gateway-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-gateway-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-gateway-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-gateway-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ts-gateway-service-config
          mountPath: /config/application.yml
          subPath: application.yml
        ports:
        - containerPort: 18888
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 18888
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
      volumes:
      - name: ts-gateway-service-config
        configMap:
          name: ts-gateway-service-config
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-gateway-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 18888
    nodePort: 30467
  selector:
    app: ts-gateway-service
  type: NodePort

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-wait-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-wait-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-wait-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-wait-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-wait-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-wait-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 17525
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 17525
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
